The document provides detailed information on the configuration settings and serving posture of ollama for the RX 9070 XT, specifically tailored for the Timmy system. Key decisions include setting OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL to 2, OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE to q8_0, and OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS to 1. These settings are based on the prediction of 1-2 requests per editor and the need to keep the memory usage efficient. The current status is that follow-up actions are planned to reclaim VRAM by lowering num_ctx to 8192.

This document outlines the configuration and status of ollama serving on the RX 9070 XT, with a focus on the Timmy inference setup. Each section details the settings for OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL, OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE, and OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS, all of which are set to manage resource usage effectively. The key decision is that every tag served on Timmy bakes num_ctx, which helps manage memory usage and prevent OOM (Out of Memory) errors. The status is open, with follow-up actions planned to reclaim VRAM by lowering num_ctx to 8192.
